description: D2: the lead toward Harrok's return (a later package builds it; nothing of it is here). Once the Stormcaller has fallen and Maera has heard it (outcome storm_fallen: lead.harrok.hearth), she tells the rumour the pilgrims bring up from the Old Kingdom: Harrok's banner is on the road again and his clan is gathering. The giant looks in at the Moot, where they last met (lead.harrok.seen) - and the lead waits for milestone E (FOLLOWUPS: Harrok's return, an ally if spared, his clan come for the throne if slain).

stages.objective: Look in at the Moot, where Harrok's banner is said to fly again
stages.waiting_text: The Moot stands in the Stonehold, north of the Giant's Stair: the ring where you and Harrok last met.
